The instrument features a symmetrical facade with towering central pipes and flanking wings of varying heights. The case is elaborately carved wood with gilded accents and classical architectural elements (columns, arches). Two individuals are seated at the console in the foreground, facing away from the camera, playing the instrument. The lighting is warm and dramatic, highlighting the metallic sheen of the pipes.
